result.summary: Found 1 issue: a raw localization key is visible as a section title instead of proper user-facing text.

issues.description: The section header displays the literal string 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated or finalized title, indicating missing localization or placeholder content.
issues.suggestion: Replace 'home_feed.popular_title' with the appropriate localized section title (e.g., 'Popular near you') and ensure all UI strings are properly internationalized before release.
